headline: Heidelberg Materials Carbon Capture Project Stalls on Investment
summary: Heidelberg Materials' proposed carbon capture project in Edmonton passed technical tests at a cement facility but failed to clear the investment test despite government subsidies.
why: Carbon capture and storage (CCS) projects involve significant capital expenditure for industrial firms aiming to reduce emissions in hard-to-abate sectors like cement, impacting their long-term capital allocation strategies.

impacts.name: Heidelberg Materials
impacts.why: Unresolved investment hurdles for major capital projects affect long-term operational expenditures and emissions compliance costs.
